title: Fancy Yellow pear diamond ring, 18K gold
subtitle: A pear diamond at center gives its color a direction — warm at the tip, broad at the shoulder. The ring was built to amplify that warmth rather than interrupt it: two white pear-shape side stones flank the center, and micro-pavé brilliants in graduated sizes line the full setting. Every white diamond in the piece creates contrast that pushes the yellow saturation of the center forward.
